claims.observation: The official full-product cut-out establishes the circular weighted base, short vertical shank, two-stage articulated arm, forward shade, and characteristic open triangular negative spaces.
The mechanism uses paired flat rectangular bars rather than cylindrical tubes; lower and upper bar pairs meet at pinned yokes and an elbow pivot.

limitations: cable overlaps part of the right side

claims.observation: The compressed official pose exposes the lower yoke, transverse pins, two external lower springs, paired arm spacing, elbow fasteners, and upper cable/tension loop.
Both arm stages remain parallel paired strips with consistent depth and narrow chamfered edge highlights through articulation.
The frontal cut-out shows a broad low circular base cover that rises smoothly to a centered cylindrical shank without a stack of ornamental rings.
Front spacing confirms the two outer springs, paired bars, central lower yoke, and transverse pin widths as a layered mechanical assembly.

limitations: front cut-out still has mild perspective

claims.observation: The shade is a continuous formed shell: straight narrow neck, smooth outward flare, broad lower bell, and a subtly rolled lower lip. A separate rear pivot plate and conical spacer connect the upper arm.
The neck terminates in a shallow recessed cap with two rings of circular ventilation holes and a centered brushed-metal switch button.

limitations: vent holes are angled ellipses in perspective

claims.observation: The official specification gives a configured size of approximately H52 x W43 x D19.5 cm, maximum horizontal reach 71 cm, and maximum vertical reach 90 cm.
The official specification gives the base diameter as 19.5 cm.
The official specification gives the shade diameter as 14.5 cm and shade height as 19.2 cm.
